# Dr. Chem

> Dr. Chem is an AI-powered virtual chemistry lab for Class 9-10 students and teachers. It provides safe interactive experiments, an AI tutor, and viva practice in Bangla and English, aligned with the Bangladesh NCTB chemistry curriculum.

Dr. Chem lets students perform chemistry experiments visually and safely — titration, pH scale, oxygen and CO₂ preparation, ionic and covalent bonding, electrochemical series, solubility, and more — and ask follow-up questions to an AI chemistry tutor grounded in the NCTB Class 9-10 textbook.

- [Home](/): Overview of Dr. Chem — what it is, who it's for, and the experiments included.
